description.value:
♉ Taurus is ascendant today. Your Cloth is awake. For the whole day your Techniques heighten as though you were 4 levels higher, and you have your Ascendant Boon.

Your unarmed Strikes gain +1 damage die, and a creature you hit must attempt a Fortitude save against your Cosmo DC or be pushed 10 feet and knocked prone.

You count as one size larger whenever it benefits you.

Granted by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-class-features.Item.Ascendant Constellation]. Applied and removed by the module's sky tracker; a GM can also drag it on by hand.

rules.text: You count as one size larger whenever that benefits you — Athletics maneuvers, being moved, and anything else the GM judges size-dependent.
rules.title: The Great Horn
